description.correction: Public SEPTA APIs provide Regional Rail arrivals, TrainView and schedules; bus and trolley schedules, locations and detours; service alerts, elevator outages, and GTFS/GTFS-RT feeds. The documented real-time features do not apply uniformly to subway/elevated lines.

notes: The official documentation is now at api.septa.org; /api is its API base path, not the documentation page, explaining the 403 on the submitted docs URL. Recent official indexing shows SEPTA endpoints remain active, so the bare-base 403 is not evidence of shutdown. No official API-wide pricing, unlimited-use guarantee, quota, or CORS policy was found.
